newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore residue stocks down, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore residue stocks down, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residues stocks fell by 162,000 barrels, to 10.431 million barrels for the week ending April 29, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) statistics showed on Wednesday.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by 747,000 barrels to 7.785 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillates stocks fell by 277,000 barrels to 7.266 million barrels.
Light distillate comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
The weekly stocks were released one day in advance due to the May Day holiday on Thursday.
